entries.name: Taiwan
entries.ownerRules: name "Taiwan", officialName "Republic of China". capital Taipei. funFact must carry the agreed status sentence verbatim: "Taiwan has its own government, elections and currency, but its status is disputed: China claims it, and most countries do not recognize it as a state." Population from UN WPP 2024 (listed there as China, Taiwan Province of China; report the figure only). Currency "New Taiwan Dollar (NT$)". Flag text: the Blue Sky with a White Sun of the Kuomintang (1895-1928 history), the red field; neutral tone.

entries.name: Afghanistan
entries.ownerRules: name "Afghanistan", officialName "Afghanistan" (the UN-listed name; the long form is contested, say so in the note only). capital Kabul. languages Pashto, Dari. Flag: write the text for the black-red-green vertical tricolour with the white emblem (the flag recognised by the UN and shown on most references); the owner will decide whether to show the white Shahada flag instead, so add one neutral clause that a white flag with the Shahada has been flown by the authorities in Kabul since 2021. Government: neutral wording, no dated claims.

entries.name: Nepal
entries.ownerRules: The flag is the only non-rectangular national flag (two stacked pennants); say so in the flag text. Open /tmp/flagwork/out/np.png and describe what the drawing shows around the pennants (white or empty) in remainingDoubts.

entries.name: Palestine
entries.ownerRules: name "Palestine", officialName "State of Palestine". capital EXACTLY "Al Quds (Jerusalem)" and quizCapital EXACTLY "Al Quds" (owner decision). currency EXACTLY "No currency of its own (shekel, Jordanian dinar and US dollar are used)". population: UN WPP 2024 row "State of Palestine". areaSqKm 6020 (West Bank and Gaza Strip). Fun fact: an ordinary one (for example Jericho, one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities). Neutral wording throughout; the flag text explains the Pan-Arab colors (Arab Revolt flag of 1916) and the 1964/1988 adoption.

entries.name: Syria
entries.ownerRules: name "Syria", officialName per the 2025 constitutional declaration (verify; "Syrian Arab Republic" if unchanged). capital Damascus. FLAG: the current national flag is the green-white-black horizontal flag with THREE red stars (the independence flag, made official in 2025); write the text for that flag and verify the drawing in /tmp/flagwork/out/sy.png shows three red stars on the white band. If the image shows two green stars, say so in remainingDoubts.
